const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera-guided control of the three cubes in RoboWits align_blocks.
+
+Run individual phases so each move can be checked against the live camera.
+The service records all submit calls; this file records the control method.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+DOWN = [0.0, 2 ** -0.5, 2 ** -0.5, 0.0]
+
+
+def current(robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True)
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return obs, now
+
+
+def save_obs(obs, name):
+    Image.fromarray(obs.last["ego"]).save(OUT / f"{name}_ego.png")
+    np.save(OUT / f"{name}_ego_depth.npy", obs.last_depth["ego"])
+    (OUT / f"{name}_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+def arm_q(row):
+    return np.r_[row[:7], row[8:15]]
+
+
+def pose_move(robot, xyz, opening, duration, name, arm="L", waypoints=5):
+    obs, now = current(robot)
+    q0 = arm_q(now)
+    p0 = now[23:26] if arm == "L" else now[16:19]
+    q_seed = q0.copy()
+    qs = []
+    for t in np.linspace(1 / waypoints, 1, waypoints):
+        p = (1 - t) * p0 + t * np.asarray(xyz)
+        result = robot.ik({f"Gripper_Tip_{arm}": [*p, *DOWN]}, seed=q_seed)
+        if not result["ok"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed at {p}: {result['error']}")
+        q_seed = np.asarray(result["q"], dtype=float)
+        qs.append(q_seed.copy())
+    target = np.asarray(now[:16], dtype=float)
+    nodes = [target.copy()]
+    for q in qs:
+        row = target.copy()
+        row[:7], row[8:15] = q[:7], q[7:]
+        row[15 if arm == "L" else 7] = opening
+        nodes.append(row)
+    count = max(int(round(duration / 0.1)), waypoints)
+    samples = []
+    for t in np.linspace(0, waypoints, count + 1):
+        i = min(int(t), waypoints - 1)
+        samples.append((1 - (t - i)) * nodes[i] + (t - i) * nodes[i + 1])
+    action = np.asarray(samples)
+    result = robot.submit("joint_position", action, dt=0.1, video="none")
+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True)
+    save_obs(obs, name)
+    print(json.dumps({"phase": name, "action": result.meta, "tcp": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][23:30], "opening": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][63], "done": obs.meta["done"], "reason": obs.meta["reason"]}, default=str))
+    return result, obs
+
+
+def grip(robot, opening, duration, name, arm="L"):
+    obs, now = current(robot)
+    target = now[:16].copy()
+    target[15 if arm == "L" else 7] = opening
+    count = int(round(duration / 0.1))
+    action = np.linspace(now[:16], target, count + 1)
+    result = robot.submit("joint_position", action, dt=0.1, video="none")
+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True)
+    save_obs(obs, name)
+    print(json.dumps({"phase": name, "action": result.meta, "tcp": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][23:30], "opening": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][63], "grip_effort": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][79], "done": obs.meta["done"], "reason": obs.meta["reason"]}, default=str))
+    return result, obs
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["approach", "descend", "grasp", "lift", "translate", "place", "release", "retreat", "observe"])
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    if args.phase == "approach":
+        pose_move(robot, [0.561, 0.160, 0.900], 0.09, 3.0, args.phase)
+    elif args.phase == "descend":
+        pose_move(robot, [0.561, 0.160, 0.783], 0.09, 2.0, args.phase)
+    elif args.phase == "grasp":
+        grip(robot, 0.0, 1.0, args.phase)
+    elif args.phase == "lift":
+        pose_move(robot, [0.561, 0.160, 0.840], 0.0, 1.5, args.phase)
+    elif args.phase == "translate":
+        pose_move(robot, [0.490, 0.130, 0.840], 0.0, 2.5, args.phase)
+    elif args.phase == "place":
+        pose_move(robot, [0.490, 0.130, 0.783], 0.0, 1.5, args.phase)
+    elif args.phase == "release":
+        grip(robot, 0.09, 0.8, args.phase)
+    elif args.phase == "retreat":
+        pose_move(robot, [0.490, 0.130, 0.900], 0.09, 2.0, args.phase)
+    elif args.phase == "observe":
+        obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True)
+        save_obs(obs, args.phase)
+        print(json.dumps({"status": robot.status(), "meta": {k: v for k, v in obs.meta.items() if k != "proprio"}}, default=str))
*** End Patch";
